dataset_name: Online Retail Data Set (UCI Machine Learning Repository)
target_variable: is_returned (1 = InvoiceNo prefixed 'C', a cancelled/returned order line; 0 = completed)
limitation: The dataset labels order CANCELLATIONS (InvoiceNo starting with 'C'), used here as the closest available real proxy for a product return, since no separate post-delivery return flag exists in the source data. The dataset also has no star-rating / review field, so this app never shows or invents a product rating.
leakage_prevention: product_prior_orders, product_prior_return_rate and product_avg_price_prior are computed per product using an expanding window over ONLY transactions that occurred strictly before the current transaction's timestamp. Train/test split is chronological (train = earliest 80% of transactions, test = most recent 20%), not random, so the model is evaluated on genuinely later, unseen orders.
train_test_split: 80% earliest transactions (train) / 20% most recent transactions (test), chronological
